newsitem.title: USA: CopyTele gets added distribution deal.
newsitem.headline: CopyTele gets added distribution deal.

text.p: CopyTele Inc said it entered into an additional distribution agreement for the sale and service of its MAGICOM 2000 product.
It said this agreement is for a term of three years and provides for the purchase of the distributor's requirements of MAGICOM 2000 units for sale in the Philippines.

The agreement continues CopyTele's plan to penetrate worldwide markets in progressive stages. The agreement provides for monthly purchase orders in increasing quantities commencing in the second calendar quarter of 1997 to be accompanied by irrevocable bank letters of credit furnished by the distributor.

The total purchase price for the total quantities contracted for sale under this distribution agreement is about $16 million bringing the total quantities contracted for sale under all distribution agreements to about $106 million.

The distributor is engaged in the distribution and service of communication products and systems. Its primary markets include commercial companies, government, common carriers, transport service companies and cellular telephone network and service providers, CopyTele said.

MAGICOM 2000, which is CopyTele's first product, is in its initial stages of production and marketing. The outcome of this agreement will depend upon many factors including those normally associated with any new product, such as the distributor's ability to market the contracted quantities in its territory as well as the capability of CopyTele to produce sufficient quantities of the product, it said.
